scope: Actual System allocator, exact isolated Rust test, no allocation meter. Two warmups per mode, five alternating pairs of 500ms no-pool idle control and live fixed executor idle. Baseline has no executor/jobs and is NOT an equivalent functional alternative; no throughput-regression or replacement claim. Pool mode separately measures 500 sequential admitted primitive jobs, an atomic 2-running+64-waiting source cancel, shutdown call, completion polling and joined cleanup. Includes Rust harness, no network/SSH/SFTP/GUI/native input. Stable libproc samples trim 50ms per edge; short idle observations are not 30-minute or full-RSS proof.
